about.title: About Us
about.p1: We are a dedicated team of experienced Quran teachers committed to educating our Muslim community about the knowledge of the Holy Quran. We have been working with students of all ages (especially children), teaching them how to recite the Arabic text of the Holy Book from the Alif Baa to reciting with tune!
about.p2: We generally start taking children as young as 4 years, and because we have both male and female teachers, we are able to teach both genders privately or in group sessions (if available).
about.p3: Our classes are conducted primarily online via Skype or Zoom. Please contact us to check availability.

about.pageSubtitle: Get to know our mission, our teaching methodology, and the certified teachers guiding your Quran learning journey.
about.title: Our Mission Is To Make Quran Learning Accessible To All
about.p1: Learn Al Quran Online BD was founded with a simple goal: to bring authentic, structured Quran education to every home, regardless of location. Whether you are a child taking your first steps in Arabic, or an adult learning to read the Quran for the first time, our certified teachers provide personalized, one-to-one classes built around your schedule.
about.p2: We combine traditional Islamic teaching methods with modern online learning tools—live video classes, structured curriculums, and continuous progress tracking—so every student, wherever they are in the world, gets the same quality of education as in a traditional madrasa.
about.p3: Our teaching staff includes certified Huffaz and Qaris, each carefully vetted for both knowledge and teaching ability before joining our platform.
about.historyBody: Learn Al Quran Online BD began as a small group of Quran teachers determined to make quality Islamic education available beyond the walls of a physical madrasa. What started with a handful of students has grown into a trusted online institution serving families across Bangladesh and abroad, built entirely on word-of-mouth trust and consistent results.
about.missionBody: To deliver authentic, structured and accessible Quran education to every Muslim household in the world, regardless of geography or schedule, through dedicated one-to-one and small-group online classes.
about.visionBody: To become the most trusted name in online Quran education, raising a generation of students who read, understand and live by the Quran with confidence and love.
about.objective1: Provide structured Quran, Tajweed and Hifz curriculums for every age group.
about.objective2: Match each student with a qualified teacher suited to their pace and goals.
about.objective3: Maintain consistent, transparent progress tracking for parents and guardians.
about.objective4: Make quality Quran education affordable and accessible worldwide.
about.onlineEduBody: All classes are conducted live over video call by qualified teachers, one-to-one or in small groups. Students receive structured lesson plans, homework and regular progress updates, bringing the discipline of a traditional madrasa into a flexible online format that fits around school, work and family life.
about.different1Body: Every teacher is a vetted, experienced Hafiz or Qari trained in Tajweed and child-friendly teaching methods.
about.different2Body: Classes are tailored to each student's age, ability and learning goals rather than a fixed curriculum for everyone.
about.different3Body: Parents and guardians receive regular updates on attendance, lessons covered and student progress.
about.methodologyBody: We follow a step-by-step approach beginning with Arabic letter recognition (Noorani Qaida), progressing through Tajweed rules, fluent recitation, and for Hifz students, structured memorization with regular revision cycles — all paced to the individual student and reinforced with regular assessment.
about.goalsBody: We are committed to providing our teachers with fair, consistent opportunities to serve the community, and to giving every student — regardless of age or background — a respectful, encouraging environment in which to learn the Quran at their own pace.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Learn Al Quran Online BD (we, our, us) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect through our website and enrollment forms, and how we use it.
privacy.collectBody: When you submit our Free Trial or Admission form, we collect your name, WhatsApp number, contact number, optional email address, and payment or transaction details solely to process your enrollment and communicate with you.
privacy.useBody: Your information is used to schedule classes, verify payments, respond to enquiries, and improve our services. We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about this policy, contact us at {email}.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.enrollmentBody: Enrollment is confirmed only after the course fee has been paid through an accepted payment method and the Admission Form has been submitted with a valid Transaction ID.
terms.refundBody: Fees are non-refundable once a teacher has been assigned and classes have started, except when Learn Al Quran Online BD is unable to provide a suitable teacher.
terms.scheduleBody: Class timing is arranged based on mutual availability between the student and teacher. Rescheduling requests should be made at least 12 hours in advance.
terms.conductBody: Students and parents are expected to maintain respectful conduct during classes. Learn Al Quran Online BD reserves the right to suspend access for any breach of conduct.
terms.contactBody: For any questions about these terms, please contact us at {email}.

returnPolicy.title: Return Policy
returnPolicy.policyBody: As our courses are personalized, live online classes, fees already paid for classes that have taken place are non-returnable. If a course package has been paid for in advance and classes have not yet started, you may request a return within 7 days of payment by contacting us.
returnPolicy.contactBody: For any questions about returns, please contact us at {email}.
